#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

long long dfs(const vector<long long>& ones, long long n, int idx) {
    long long quot = n / ones[idx];
    n %= ones[idx];
    long long onesUsedHere = quot * idx;
    if (n == 0) return onesUsedHere;
    else {
        long long option1 = dfs(ones, n, idx - 1);
        long long option2 = idx + dfs(ones, ones[idx] - n, idx - 1);
        return onesUsedHere + min(option1, option2);
    }
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<long long> ones(17, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
        ones[i] = 10 * ones[i - 1] + 1;
    }
    long long ans = dfs(ones, n, 16);
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
